result_identity: Compare results within one profile. Controlled runs share fixture bytes. Original-compatible runs share workload distributions and lifecycle, with independent random inputs.

restrictions: FFI registrations use i32 and i64

defaults.warmup_policy: Fresh queue and same fixture for every unreported trial

reservation.exception_policy: Provide maximum live queue size before timing and disclose required-capacity backend policy in results

inside: Derive monotone push from preceding tested-queue pop

fixture.digest: fnv1a64:<16 lowercase hexadecimal digits>, exact file bytes
fixture.keys: Unsigned bit patterns at declared element width; signed decoding uses two's complement
fixture.offsets: Unsigned u64 values independent of element width; arithmetic overflow validation runs before timing

generator.algorithm: SplitMix64 with unbiased modulo rejection for bounded integers
generator.portability: Active integer workloads regenerate identically across C++ standard libraries; shared files define identity for dormant geometric sampling

build_identity.cpp: Compiler/version, build type and flags, options, source sha256, resolved Quickheap/Highway package content sha256
build_identity.rust: Resolved rustc version, target, optimization, features, flags, source fnv1a64 including Cargo.lock
build_identity.baseline_pins: revisions identifies audited historical sources, not modified build contents

graph.dijkstra: directed arcs; u32 checked distance; source zero

controlled-operations.comparison: Identical fixture bytes and selected workload operations; implementation equivalence remains catalog-specific

generator.cpp: Fresh inputs drawn from C++ mt19937_64 stream seeded per element-type sweep; same distributions, independent sequences

original-rust.rust_fixture_digest: unavailable; original runner exports neither inputs nor seed
original-rust.schedule: Element type, upstream heap order, size, active workload order

cutoff.rule: Median above cutoff disables larger sizes for that heap/workload

table.registrations: Production and development SIMD only; original runner returns before other registrations

original-rust.comparison: Workload distribution, reservation, lifecycle, and schedule compatibility; identical inputs and algorithm parity are not implied
original-rust.known_execution_gap: Unchanged original development crate fails E0133 at quickheap-dev/src/lib.rs:331 on current nightly
